venue.deleteConfirm: Do you want to delete the venue {name}?
venue.listDescription: Buildings and sites with items to book.
venue.emptyDescription: Create your first venue to get started.
venue.notFound: The venue does not exist or is archived.
venue.createDescription: Enter details about the venue. You can add items afterwards.
venue.itemsEmpty: No items at this venue yet.

descriptions.contact: How to reach the venue, when it is open and its default VAT.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.description: Used to warn when a booking falls outside opening hours. It never blocks a booking.
hours.empty: No opening hours set. Bookings are not checked against opening hours.

item.listDescription: What you sell and book, e.g. rooms, dishes and equipment. The type decides which fields an item has.
item.createDescription: Pick a type and fill in the details.
item.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the item {name}?
item.emptyDescription: Create an item type under Types, then add items.
item.noTypes: There are no item types yet. Create a type first.
item.saveBundleDescription: Pick a bundle type and its parts. The bundle is shown only for this customer; the catalog is unchanged.
item.bundlesEmpty: No bundles for this customer yet.
item.bundlesNoTypes: There is no item type with the Bundle capability yet. Create one under Types first.
item.setupsHint: Capacity, max number of people, per setup. Leave empty for setups that are not used.
item.noSetups: There are no setups. Create them under Setups.

parts.hint: The items this item contains, with quantity and timing relative to its start.

customisationGroups.hint: Groups of other items to choose between, each with how many to pick and what an option does to the price.
customisationGroups.name: Name

item.customisationGroupValue: {name}: choose {min, number}{same, select, true {} other {–{max, number}}} of {options, number}

descriptions.type: Pick the item type. It decides which fields the item has.
descriptions.details: Name the item and fill in the fields of its type.
descriptions.setup: Set the price, booking, setups and contents.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.description: When this item is available, for example a person or a room. It never blocks a booking.
hours.followsVenue: No own hours: this item follows its venue's opening hours.
hours.followHint: Switch off every day and remove all exceptions to follow the venue's opening hours again.

itemState.listDescription: The states a line can be in, per item type. The flags decide what the system does; nothing else about a state is fixed. Every type needs one initial state.
itemState.createDescription: Add a state to {type}: name it, pick a color and choose what it does.
itemState.editDescription: Rename, recolor or change what the state does.
itemState.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the state {name}? Lines in it, grid cells and the expiry state move to the state you choose.
itemState.archiveInitialConfirm: {name} is the initial state. Make another state initial before archiving it. Lines in it move to the state you choose.
itemState.noTypesDescription: Create an item type first. Its states are set up here.
itemState.transitionsDescription: Choose which states a line in {name} may move to.
itemState.releasedTransitions: {name} is a released state: it is final and nothing leaves it.
itemState.noTargets: There are no other states to move to.

fields.name: Name
fields.hold: What it does to the item

flagChoices.inRunSheets: Lines are included in run sheets
flagChoices.released: Final: the hold is dropped and nothing leaves it
flagChoices.expires: Falls to the expiry state when the order's hold date passes

itemDemand.formDescription: What this item asks of a pool each time it is booked.

fields.required: Mandatory (a booking is refused when no unit is free)

setup.listDescription: How a space can be set up, e.g. Cinema, U-shape or Mingle, and how long the changeover takes.
setup.createDescription: Name the setup and enter the changeover time.
setup.editDescription: Change the name and changeover time.
setup.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the setup {name}?
setup.emptyDescription: Create setups such as Cinema, U-shape and Mingle.

itemTypeGroup.listDescription: The headings your item types are sorted under, e.g. Spaces and Food. Items shows one tab per group.
itemTypeGroup.editDescription: Change the name of the group.
itemTypeGroup.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the group {name}? Its types become ungrouped.
itemTypeGroup.emptyDescription: Create groups such as Spaces, Food and Extras to sort your item types.

entityType.listDescription: Types decide which fields and capabilities items, customers and orders have in your organization.
entityType.createDescription: Choose what the type is for and name it.
entityType.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the type {name}? This is refused while it is in use.
entityType.emptyDescription: Create a type, e.g. Conference room or Dish, and add its fields.
entityType.imported: {created, plural, one {# type} other {# types}} created, {skipped} already existed.

descriptions.base: Choose what the type is for and name it.
descriptions.capabilities: Pick what items of this type can do. You add its fields next.

entityType.sectionsHint: Switch on the parts an item of this type needs. A section cannot be switched off while items have data for it.

PRICED.title: Pricing
PRICED.description: Items have a price, a price unit and VAT.

BOOKABLE.title: Availability
BOOKABLE.description: Items take up time and have a default length. Set the default setup and teardown time here.

SETUPS.title: Room layouts
SETUPS.description: Each item has layouts with a capacity per layout.

CUSTOMISATIONS.title: Customisations
CUSTOMISATIONS.description: Groups of options the customer can choose between.

fieldDefinition.createDescription: The field appears on every record of the type.
fieldDefinition.editDescription: Change the field. The value type cannot change once there are values.
fieldDefinition.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the field {name}?
fieldDefinition.noLists: There are no lists. Create one under Lists.

vocabulary.listDescription: Your own word lists, e.g. allergens or dress code, that fields and requirements point to.
vocabulary.createDescription: Name the list and optionally add the first values.
vocabulary.editDescription: Change the name of the list.
vocabulary.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the list {name}? This is refused while a field uses it.
vocabulary.emptyDescription: Create a list or import the EU's 14 allergens.

value.heading: List values
value.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the value {name}?
value.name: Value

alternativeGroup.description: Lines the customer picks one of, e.g. Room A or Room B. The quote counts the cheapest as a from price until one is chosen.
alternativeGroup.createDescription: Pick two or more lines the customer chooses between. Each keeps its own state and hold.
alternativeGroup.archiveConfirm: Dissolve “{name}”? Its options become ordinary lines and keep their states.
alternativeGroup.chooseDone: The option was chosen and the others released.

requirement.createDescription: Count how many need a value from one of your lists, e.g. Gluten × 3. On a line the count replaces the order's for that value. Counts only, never names.
requirement.editDescription: Change the count or the type's fields.
requirement.archiveConfirm: Do you want to remove the count for "{name}"?
requirement.taken: There is already a count for this value here. Edit it instead.
requirement.empty: The order has no requirements yet.

priceList.listDescription: Customer prices: a general discount or agreed prices per item, optionally for one customer and a period.
priceList.createDescription: Name the price list, pick the customer and set either a general discount or, afterwards, item prices.
priceList.editDescription: Change the name, customer, validity or general discount.
priceList.archiveConfirm: Do you want to archive the price list {name}? New order lines will no longer use its prices.
priceList.archived: The price list has been archived.
priceList.created: The price list has been created.
priceList.updated: The price list has been updated.
priceList.emptyDescription: Create a price list for a framework agreement, e.g. 15 % off for a customer.
priceList.discountHint: A price list has either a general discount or item prices, never both. Leave the discount empty to set item prices.

pricing.items: {count, plural, =0 {No item prices} one {# item price} other {# item prices}}

items.title: Item prices – {name}
items.description: Agreed prices per item. Saving replaces the whole set.
items.saved: The item prices have been saved.

descriptions.identity: Name the price list and pick the customer it is for, if any.
descriptions.terms: Set when it is valid and a general discount.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: Your changes to this layout are not saved yet.

size.label: Size
size.reset: Reset to the library's size and chairs

chairs.label: Chairs
chairs.hint: Chairs on each side of the table.

summary.seatsAndCapacity: {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} · capacity {capacity}

menu.label: More
menu.typeCapacity: Type a capacity (now {seats} from the seats)

start.title: Start the {setup} layout
start.partial: Only {placed} of {wanted} fit in this room.

capacityDialog.title: Type a capacity
capacityDialog.description: Use a typed capacity instead of the {seats} seats, for example for standing guests. It is saved with the layout.

roomDialog.title: Edit the room's size
roomDialog.description: Width and depth in metres. The room keeps its shape and is stretched to this size.

noKinds.title: No furniture yet
noKinds.description: Layouts are drawn with your organization's furniture: tables, rows of chairs, doors. Import a starter set and edit it later.
noKinds.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to add furniture

walls.hint: Drag a corner to move the walls. Click + to add a corner, double-click a corner to delete it.

create.title: Create layout
create.description: A room can be furnished several ways in the same setup, for example Banquet 60 and Banquet 80. The setup's capacity is its largest layout.
create.name: Name

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.description: The layout and its furniture are removed. The setup's capacity then comes from the room's other layouts.

noLayouts.title: No layouts yet
noLayouts.description: Create a layout to draw how the room is furnished in one of its setups.
noLayouts.noSetups: Give the item a setup first (Edit the item), then create its layouts.

section.title: Layouts
section.noSetups: The item has no setups yet.
